msg: Hi! I was born in Cartagena but I've lived in Miami since I was a baby, I only have an American passport. I want to try the mini course. Do I pay in pesos or dollars?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Since you live in Miami and have an American passport, you’d pay in **US dollars**. The mini-course has a **10% online discount** when booked directly through our website.

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

Are you leaving from Cartagena or already staying on the Rosario Islands?

msg: From Cartagena, I'm staying in Bocagrande. Can I book for Saturday? Send me the link.
reply:
Yes, you can book for Saturday through the website. The booking system closes at 4:30 PM the day before, so please use the link to check the date and complete your booking. The 10% online discount is applied automatically.

https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en

There is always availability: we operate every day, including public holidays, except December 25 and January 1; if sea conditions are not safe, the trip is rescheduled.

And how many people should I plan for? That way I can give you the exact price. 😊
